notes: MinIO is an S3-compatible object store addressed through the minio JS client (AWS S3 XML protocol), not a JSON REST API, so this OpenAPI document is synthesized from the adaptor surface (ast.json). Verified against ast.json: all 6 public operations are covered — createBucket, listObjects, getObject, putObject, getObjectTags, setObjectTags. Common/utility exports are excluded as they are not external calls. Note this is the MinIO adaptor surface, not the full S3 REST API (that lives under the aws-s3 adaptor).
